convert_modular_file: convert a modular_xxx.py file into all model-specific generated Python files
run_converter: run the modular file converter and save resulting model files to disk
save_modeling_files: save converted modular output files and run ruff linter on each
create_modules: create all new model-specific modules from a visited modular file mapper
run_ruff: run ruff linter and formatter on a generated Python file
